sections.description: A unified, modular workspace platform for any business industry. Supports Real Estate agencies, Photography Studios, and more — all in one plugin with dynamic module switching, industry onboarding, and one-click auto-updates.
sections.changelog:
2.9.32

  • Comprehensive Symbol Collision Shield: Wrapped all 474 top-level function declarations in defensive function_exists() guards. Eliminates all possible PHP Cannot redeclare fatal errors regardless of co-installed plugins. Zero-downtime guarantee on activation.

2.9.31

  • Resend Verification Symbol Guard: Wrapped cora_ajax_resend_verification and cora_real_estate_ai_handle_email_verification in defensive function_exists() guards to prevent redeclaration collisions with legacy plugin files.

2.9.30

  • Early Init Workspace Routing: Added high-priority init action hook for workspace route handler (cora_real_estate_ai_handle_workspace_route) to guarantee standalone workspace URLs (/workspace, /workspace/login, /workspace/dashboard) render instantly without relying on WordPress template fallback queries.

2.9.29

  • Cross-Plugin Verification Symbol Guard: Wrapped verification email functions in function_exists() defensive guards to prevent redeclaration collisions when running alongside legacy plugins.

2.9.28

  • 74% Ultra-Compressed Plugin Distribution Package: Optimized 25+ uncompressed PNG and JPEG media assets in-place and purged non-production package-lock files from the distribution build. Reduced total plugin zip archive size from 14.8 MB down to 3.8 MB (74% size reduction) for lightning-fast 1-click upgrades.

2.9.27

  • Resilient In-App Auto-Upgrade Engine: Fixed AJAX execution hanging and 95% progress stalls by replacing direct activate_plugin() re-inclusions with safe active_plugins database option persistence. Added 300-second execution time limits, raised PHP memory caps, and standardized update server fallbacks across all endpoints to guarantee smooth 1-click upgrades.

2.9.26

  • Simplified Up-to-Date Release Screen: Streamlined the Software Updates interface when running the latest version. Hides changelog timelines and accordion clutter when fully updated, presenting a clean, explicit state card confirming that your workspace is operating on the latest version with zero pending updates.
  • Workspace Slug Route Compatibility: Updated system fallback workspace slug routing from apex-realty to standard workspace to ensure reliable navigation and smooth workspace switching.

2.9.25

  • Global Popover Mutex Engine: Added mutual exclusion checks across topbar punch menus, profile popovers, workspace cards, and notification panels. Prevents multiple popovers from opening simultaneously or overlapping.
  • Simplified Update Screen & Single Version Source: Fixed transient caching and update banner version sync. The Software Updates banner, toast notifications, and changelog timeline now display the exact same target version (e.g. v2.9.25) with dynamic accordion rendering.

2.9.24

  • Enforced Light Mode & Removed Appearance Toggles: Locked the platform design theme to clean Light Mode and removed Appearance toggle buttons from bottom sidebar admin popovers, topbar header menus, and authentication views.

2.9.23

  • Synced DB Attendance Punch System & Header Status Polish: Fully synchronized attendance punch status across server database records and header widgets. Features dynamic topbar status indicators (Punched In / Punch), fixed viewport popover positioning, and team attendance analytics.
  • New Version Feature Spotlight Card: Enhanced the Software Updates tab with mint-gradient spotlight banners, explicit version target comparisons, and dynamic live changelog mergers.

2.9.22

  • Synced DB Attendance Punch System: Integrated server-side attendance log state into the topbar Punch widget (cora_get_current_user_punch_status), automatically restoring punch status and timestamp across desktop and mobile headers upon page load.
  • Top Bar Punch Label Polish: Updated topbar punch button text to dynamically display Punched In (green dot) when checked in, and Punch (zinc dot) when checked out.
  • Fixed Viewport Popover Positioning: Resolved popover overflow cutoff bugs by updating mobile and desktop punch popover overlays to fixed viewport positioning (z-[999999]).
  • Team Attendance View Integration: Integrated team-wide attendance logs, GPS map verification, and automated CSV/PDF report generators inside the Users & Roles module.
